page_title: ROM 0-1 TOR | AS Roma v Torino 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+9' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
90+9' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes it short.
90+8' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Torino.

90+7' Franco Israel is a nightmare for the offensive players! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save.

90+6' A bullet header by Matias Soule (AS Roma) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
90+3' Matias Soule (AS Roma) blows a clear opportunity! He sends a rebound from close range narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
90+2' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and it's Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+2' The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.

90+1' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save. AS Roma win a corner.
90+1' AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+1' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
89' He should have scored! Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
87' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and signals a foul after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) brought his opponent down.
86' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
84' Substitution. Faustino Anjorin (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nikola Vlasic walks off.
81' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) is given a yellow card.
81' Ivan Ilic (Torino) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
80' Kristjan Asllani comes off the pitch to be replaced by Adrien Tameze (Torino).
80' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Angelino will be replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Hermoso departs the field of play to be replaced by Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
77' Angelino (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
77' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul after Angelino (AS Roma) hacks down one of his opponents. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.
75' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
74' Ivan Ilic (Torino) brings an opponent down and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
70' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
69' A cross from a corner kick by AS Roma is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
65' Here comes a substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Bryan Cristante.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giovanni Simeone leaves the pitch and Che Adams (Torino) comes on.
65' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Cesare Casadei is replaced by Ivan Ilic (Torino).
64' Cyril Ngonge will be replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino).
63' Good team movement sets up Matias Soule (AS Roma) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
61' The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.

59' 0 - 1 Brilliant finish! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Cyril Ngonge, then produced a nice strike into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.

57' What a big chance! Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
55' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.

54' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
52' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Wesley Franca (AS Roma), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
52' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Cesare Casadei (Torino). Giovanni Ayroldi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
49' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Half-time substitution. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will not participate anymore and Tommaso Baldanzi is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Evan Ferguson and Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the right side of the goal. Franco Israel is alert, though, and makes a great save to deny him.
45+2' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) was too forceful with his tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
44' Giovanni Ayroldi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) and blew his whistle. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.
42' Angelino (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
41' A long pass, executed by Kristjan Asllani (Torino), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
39' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

38' Matias Soule (AS Roma) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Matias Soule (AS Roma) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
35' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) sees a yellow card from Giovanni Ayroldi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

35' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
34' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) prepares to take a corner kick.

34' A long pass finds Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
32' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Kristjan Asllani (Torino) for a tough tackle.
30' Manu Kone (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Giovanni Ayroldi signals a foul. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
29' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
28' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) sends a long ball in, but Mile Svilar comfortably gathers the ball.
26' A cooling break is underway.
25' Manu Kone (AS Roma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' Saul Coco (Torino) makes a slide tackle, but referee Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
18' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
14' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
13' Flag up against Giovanni Simeone (Torino). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
12' Kristjan Asllani (Torino) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mile Svilar reads it well and gathers the ball.
10' The AS Roma players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
7' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
5' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
2' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Giovanni Ayroldi will supervise the game today.
